visualization.name: WARC Explorer
visualization.description: Explore archived web records, headers, and payloads
visualization.help:
Browse a gzip-compressed WARC dataset using the National Library of Norway's [WARC Explorer](https://github.com/NationalLibraryOfNorway/webdata-warc-explorer).
Filter by record type, search URIs or record IDs, and inspect WARC headers, HTTP headers, and text or binary payloads. Save a view to reopen its filters and selected record. Viewing a shared visualization also requires access to its underlying dataset.
Archives are indexed in your browser when opened. Selected records use HTTP byte ranges when available. Files compressed as a single gzip member are read sequentially for record inspection, which can be slower. The record list is virtualized; decoded payload previews are limited to 16 MiB.
HTML previews are static and isolated: scripts and live resource requests are blocked. This is a record inspector rather than a full archived-site replay system. No archive data is sent to a third-party service.
